narr: A few storms developed during the afternoon and early evening hours of the 4th across east-central Minnesota in the wake of a warm front. A few of the stronger storms produced minor wind damage in the I-35 corridor of east-central Minnesota along with heavy rainfall resulting in minor road washouts.
ev: A few roads were washed out by the heavy rainfall just south of Automba on CR 135 and near the intersection of CR 135 and CR12. Water was quickly receding.
lsr: There was a report of a road that washed out less than 1 mile to the north of this location around 7 PM, and other washouts along CR135 near CR12 around 830 PM, but water was receding at that time. L
